array.title: Array
array.description: An array is a fixed-size collection of elements stored in order, where each element can be accessed directly by its index.

linked-list.title: Linked List
linked-list.description: A linked list is a linear collection of nodes, where each node contains data and a reference to the next node in sequence.

binary-search-tree.title: Binary Search Tree
binary-search-tree.description: A binary search tree stores elements in nodes, ensuring left children are smaller and right children are larger than their parent node.

red-black-tree.title: Red-Black Tree
red-black-tree.description: A red-black tree is a self-balancing binary search tree that maintains balance using color properties and rotation rules.

max-heap.title: Max Heap
max-heap.description: A max heap is a complete binary tree where the value of each node is greater than or equal to the values of its children.
